name: David Thomas
business: Artisan bakery and café in Bangalore
language_style: Polite formal English with occasional Indian English phrases
temperament: polite but non-committal, asks many questions without promising anything
opening_line: Hello, this is David from Thomas Bakes. I saw your ad for bulk flour supply. Just exploring options for now.

hidden_facts.budget: around 35-45k per month, but wants a 10k trial order first
hidden_facts.timeline: current contract ends in 6 weeks, looking to switch before that
hidden_facts.products_count: needs 500kg of premium wheat flour and 200kg almond flour monthly
hidden_facts.features: must be organic-certified, consistent protein content for bread, gluten-free option for almond flour
hidden_facts.decision_maker: David co-owns with his wife; she handles accounts and must approve any new vendor
hidden_facts.barrier: current supplier gives 45-day credit; new supplier must match or beat that term

indirect_phrases: I'll need to discuss with my wife before we commit
